children: 7 Siblings borrowed 20 million USDS from Spark eight hours ago and bought 12,085 ETH at $1,655 per coin. According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember reported that the address 0x5ffc...33c37 has spent 85.96 million U over the past half-month to buy 46,528 ETH at an average price of $1,847 per coin, and currently has an unrealized loss of $10.75 million.

title: 7 Siblings Borrows 20 Million USDS From Spark to Buy 12,085 ETH
